sync.title: Who Captures the Value of AI?
sync.rawTitle: #13 - Daniel Martínez: Who Captures the Value of AI? | Leading in AI Podcast
sync.youtubeDescription:
Daniel Martínez is a PhD candidate at Esade, where he researches how generative AI is reshaping knowledge-intensive professional services such as law and consulting. Before academia, he spent nearly two decades in consulting, audit, compliance and legal operations, including several years at EY, before leaving in 2021 to pursue research.

In this episode, Daniel explains who really captures the value AI creates inside professional firms, why knowledge alone is no longer a competitive advantage, and what the traditional pyramid model means for juniors entering the industry.

Topics covered:
- From computer engineering to IT audit, internal audit and consulting
- Leaving a 20-year career for a PhD after the Executive MBA at Esade
- What professional experience brings to research, and what to unlearn
- Working with Esteve Almirall as his supervisor
- Who captures the value of AI: the firm, the professional, the tech provider or the client
- How AI turns low-capital firms into infrastructure-heavy businesses
- Moving from delivering knowledge to helping clients implement it
- The junior paradox: AI needs expert judgment, but cuts the roles that build it
- Advice for graduates: develop criteria and learn to challenge AI
- What comes next: physical and screenless AI
